journey.name: TL-15 A restore that fails halfway brings the task back unfinished
journey.description:
KNOWN-DEFECT WATCHLIST. Asserts the current behaviour; whether it is the right behaviour is a product call. See qa/TEST-PLAN.md.
RestoreTaskUseCase is two calls, not one: createTask, then setCompleted for a task that was completed. TaskApi has no restore operation and TaskDraft deliberately carries only the editable half of a task, so the flag has to be re-applied afterwards - and nothing makes the pair atomic. When the second call fails, the task is back on the list reading as unfinished, under a network snackbar that says nothing about the flag having been dropped.
TL-07 covers the pair when both calls succeed. This is the seam between them, and the reason it is a device journey rather than a unit test is that the unit test asserts a reported failure while the user sees a row that quietly changed meaning.
Timing. The dice for a call are rolled at its start, so the broadcast must land after createTask has begun and before setCompleted does. Pinning the latency at 4000 ms opens a four-second window for it. If the create itself fails instead - the failure snackbar appears and "Book dentist" does not come back at all - the broadcast was too early: force-stop, restart and run the journey again rather than recording a failure.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0 --es qa_latency_ms 4000

actions.action: Verify that the "Book dentist" row has a checked checkbox
Tap the element with the content description "Delete task" on the "Book dentist" row
Verify that a message reading "Task deleted" is on screen
Tap the "Undo" action on that message

Using adb, break the source one second later, while the restore is still in flight, with `am broadcast -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.qa.QaControlReceiver -a com.rounds.test.to_dolist.QA_SET_FAILURE_RATE --es qa_failure_rate 1.0`
Verify that "Book dentist" is on screen again
Verify that "No connection. Check your network and try again." is on screen
Verify that the restored "Book dentist" row has an unchecked checkbox described as "Mark complete"
Verify that the restored "Book dentist" title is not struck through
